summary_1line: Varuna grants Arjuna the Gandiva bow, inexhaustible quivers, and a celestial chariot, while Krishna receives the discus and mace before Agni begins burning Khandava forest.

image_candidates.scene_text: Varuna presents the radiant Gandiva bow and inexhaustible quivers to Arjuna beside the blazing god Agni.
Arjuna stands on the celestial chariot with an ape-banner, stringing the Gandiva as the thunderous twang terrifies onlookers.
Agni surrounds the Khandava forest with towering flames while Krishna holds the discus and Arjuna stands ready on his chariot.
